decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana production with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and use green devotion to power up creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional support and card advantage. Storm the Festival helps to fetch more creatures and Boseiju, Who Endures protects important spells. Wolfwillow Haven and mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic accelerate the deck's game plan while Cityscape Leveler and Cavalier of Thorns provide additional threats and flexibility.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and disrupting their strategies using cards like Path to the World Tree, Leyline Binding, and Chained to the Rocks. It aims to set up an engine with Enigmatic Incarnation and Fires of Invention to cheat out powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Omnath, and Atraxa. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for extra value and flexibility in the deck. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent through efficient removal and powerful creature plays.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive plays with a mix of burn spells, creature threats, and pump effects. The goal is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to deal early damage while attacking with efficient creatures like Anax, Hardened in the Forge. The deck also includes cards like Atarka's Command and Reckless Bushwhacker to boost damage output and close out games swiftly. By taking advantage of its curve and synergies, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents by quickly building a board of small, aggressive creatures known as "Weenies". The key strategy is to play multiple low-cost creatures each turn, boosting their power and toughness with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Brave the Elements. Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provide additional support for the weenie army, while Castle Ardenvale and Mutavault offer extra utility and flexibility. The goal is to flood the board with creatures and swarm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo by using cards like Raffine's Informant and Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create tokens and trigger powerful effects from cards like Parhelion II and Esika's Chariot. It also includes a mix of removal, disruption, and graveyard recursion to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and synergistic interactions while also being able to disrupt their strategy and grind out advantage in longer games.

The primary goal of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By combining powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with versatile lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance, the deck seeks to maintain board presence and close out games swiftly.

This deck aims to utilize cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn. The deck also utilizes the sacrifice mechanic with cards like Witch's Oven and Unlucky Witness to gain advantage and trigger abilities like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mayhem Devil. The deck also includes disruption and hand control elements with cards like Thoughtseize. Additionally, the deck can utilize Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for added consistency.

This deck focuses on aggression with low-cost creatures and pump effects to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing efficient weenies like Hopeful Initiate and Thalia's Lieutenant, alongside protection cards like Brave the Elements and Dauntless Bodyguard, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on. Adeline, Resplendent Cathar provides a powerful anthem effect to boost the team, while cards like Brutal Cathar and Giant Killer offer additional removal options. The inclusion of lands like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale ensures consistent mana production for sustained pressure.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks. By playing efficient creatures like Knight-Errant of Eos and Regal Leosaur, and supplementing them with support spells like Resolute Reinforcements and Venerated Loxodon, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they can stabilize. With a mix of creatures, combat tricks, and removal spells, this deck aims to be proactive and maintain a high tempo throughout the game.

This Goblin aggro deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence, overwhelming opponents with multiple low-cost creatures and utilizing cards like Legion Loyalist and Foundry Street Denizen to maximize damage output. The deck also includes cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Rundvelt Hordemaster to generate additional value and create explosive turns. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, this deck aims to quickly close out games before opponents can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing ramp cards like Lotus Cobra and Sylvan Caryatid to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. The deck also includes control elements such as Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light and Escape to the Wilds allows for flexibility and the ability to search for key cards. Overall, the strategy revolves around ramping up mana, controlling the board, and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threatening creatures from the opponent. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control of the board to secure a quick victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through countermagic, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes powerful cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon to generate value and control the board. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional card advantage and flexibility. By controlling the game and generating card advantage, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plays and controlling the game through counterspells and removal spells. It aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant position with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and The Wandering Emperor. Memory Deluge helps maintain card advantage, while Shark Typhoon provides a win condition. The mana base is built to support the control elements of the deck, with utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Castle Vantress. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a game of attrition.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying small, efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression. Cards like Adeline, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Coppercoat Vanguard provide a strong board presence, while Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's spells. The inclusion of cards like Giant Killer and Castle Ardenvale help control the board and protect the creatures. The deck aims to curve out with low-cost creatures and use Brave the Elements to protect them, while Ossification provides a way to deal with larger threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the battlefield with low-cost, aggressive white creatures and pump them up with various anthem effects. By utilizing cheap but powerful creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia's Lieutenant, this deck can overwhelm opponents with sheer numbers and buffs. Brutal Cathar and Ossification provide removal options, while Brave the Elements protects your creatures and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire helps keep them safe. Mutavault and Shefet Dunes offer additional utility and options for pumping up your team, making this deck a formidable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.
